findings.message: references 3 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes request-controlled input directly to a dynamic code evaluation API
findings.remediation: Remove dynamic evaluation and dispatch request values through a fixed allowlist of implementations.
findings.impact: Request-controlled dynamic evaluation can execute arbitrary code within the plugin process.
findings.attack_vector: A request body, query, parameter, header, argv, or input value reaches eval() or Function().
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: accesses system or user credential stores (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Avoid direct access to credential files; use authenticated API flows instead.
findings.impact: Direct access to system credential stores allows theft of SSH keys, AWS creds, and Docker tokens.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: uses string concatenation or char-code construction to hide keywords
findings.remediation: Use readable, explicit code patterns; avoid character-code obfuscation.
findings.impact: Character-code construction hides string literals from grep-based detection.
findings.attack_vector: String.fromCharCode() builds dangerous strings at runtime — evades static patterns.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and use a fixed allowlisted command with bounded arguments.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, leading to full system compromise.
findings.attack_vector: Plugin spawns a child process with attacker-controlled arguments; no user approval gate.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.

findings.message: passes a private, loopback, or link-local address to a network API
findings.remediation: Allowlist public destinations and reject loopback, RFC1918, and link-local targets before making requests.
findings.impact: Requests to private or loopback addresses can reach internal services that are not publicly exposed.
findings.attack_vector: A network API receives a literal RFC1918, loopback, or link-local URL without an allowlist check.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
